simple.meaning: יָמַר (yâmar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to exchange ; by implication, to change places.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 61:6. The surrounding contexts include priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָמַר (H3235) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: יָמַר (yâmar) / H3235 is traced through Isaiah 61:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to exchange ; by implication, to change places
definitions.full: H3235. yamar ימר verb assumed in Thes to explain Hiph`il הֵימִיר = הֵמִיר Jer 2:11 , and Hithpa`el תִּתְיַמָּ֑רוּ Isa 61:6 ; but on הימיר see מור (Kö i. 457 ), and תִּתְיַמָּ֑רוּ is probably from אמר q. v. above. יִמְרָה see below מרה .

occurrences.englishText: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests.
